about.title: About Laparli
about.subtitle: We build calm, structured language journeys — one lesson, one quiz, and one small win at a time.
about.missionBody: Laparli started with a simple idea: language learning should feel clear, not overwhelming. We combine CEFR-aligned paths, bite-sized lessons, and meaningful quizzes so learners stay motivated without losing the joy of discovery.
about.valuesSubtitle: Four principles that shape every feature we ship.

0.title: Structured progress
0.description: Every level has a purpose. Grammar, vocabulary, visuals, and quizzes work together instead of competing for attention.

1.title: Learning that sticks
1.description: Short sessions, spaced repetition, and quizzes that explain mistakes help knowledge move from memory to real use.

2.title: Respect for the learner
2.description: No noise, no dark patterns. Clear paths, honest pricing, and tools that respect your time and pace.

3.title: Languages for everyone
3.description: Italian is live today. English, German, and Turkish are growing — with room for more voices and cultures ahead.

timeline.title: How we got here
timeline.subtitle: A quick look at the Laparli journey so far.

idea.title: The idea
idea.description: A small team asked: what if language apps felt more like a thoughtful classroom than a gamified maze?

italian.title: Italian goes live
italian.description: We launched a full A1 Italian path with admin tools to customize levels and content without touching code.

multilingual.title: Multilingual expansion
multilingual.description: Super admins can enable new languages and build custom CEFR roadmaps as content becomes ready.

future.title: What comes next
future.description: Subscriptions, richer analytics, and deeper personalization — always in service of clearer learning.

about.communityBody: Whether you are an admin shaping curriculum or a learner opening your first lesson, Laparli is designed to meet you where you are — and help you take the next step with confidence.
